title: Run halt body
description: A halted run (register rows DK1230 and its successors; spec-delta S1422): the gateway, or a watchdog, stopped an agent's run because it looped, recursed too deep, spent its daily tokens, repeated a call with small changes, was part of an agent-to-agent cycle or its fleet drained its budget. Signed by the agent (the gateway holds the key of the agent it wraps), its sponsor or the operator, for a contract the agent performs. From the record on, the Mandate of that contract buys nothing (`run_halted`): credits stop draining. It is a record of what happened and of what the gateway counted, never a slash and never a strike. A new contract and Mandate are a fresh start. Chain: none (prev is null).

count.description: How many equivalent or near-equivalent calls, or the depth, the gateway counted.

limit.description: The limit of the Mandate that was reached.

tool.description: The tool the loop was calling, never its arguments.

node.description: For a fleet halt: the tree node whose members were halted.
